_about: Public-domain Matthew Richey (1803-1883), Wesleyan Methodist minister in Nova Scotia and Upper Canada and first principal of Upper Canada Academy, for the Word Hoard: A Short and Scriptural Method with Antipedobaptists, A Memoir of William Black, Sermons on Various Occasions, The Exalted Objects of the Christian Ministry, A Plain Statement of Facts on the Methodist union, a letter to the editor of The Church, a Toronto dedication sermon, a YMCA address, The Spirit of Popery, and a funeral sermon for William Croscombe. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 102 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

richey-antipedobaptists: A short and scriptural method with Antipedobaptists (Halifax, N. S., Printed by J.S. Cunnabell, 1835)
richey-memoir-black: A Memoir of the Late Rev. William Black, Wesleyan Minister, Halifax. N.S.: Including an Account (William Cunnabell, 1839)

richey-plain-statement: A plain statement of facts, connected with the union and separation of the British and Canadian conferences ([Toronto? : s.n.], 1840)
richey-letter-church: A letter to the editor of The Church : in answer to his remarks on the Rev. Thomas Powell's essay on apostolical succession (Kingston, Ont. : [s.n.], 1843)
richey-toronto-dedication: A sermon preached at the dedication of the Wesleyan Methodist Church, Ricmond Street, Toronto, on Sunday, June 29, 1845 : and of the Wesleyan Methodist Church, Great St. James Street, Montreal, on Sunday, July 27, 1845 (London : J . Mason ; Montreal : Wesleyan Book Depot, 1845)
richey-ymca-address: An address at the inauguration of the Halifax Young Men's Christian Association ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1854)

richey-croscombe: A sermon occasioned by the death of the Rev. William Croscombe : preached in Windsor, 30th October, and in Halifax, 6th November, 1859 ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1859)
